phoenix.//: Not in the launcher: the app carries the Unofficial Telegram account (accounts/signin.html, the template in public/accounts, the service). Chats are in Messaging; sharing to a person goes through Messaging's share target. Named and drawn as Telegram's API terms ask of a third-party client: not 'Telegram', not its logo. It needs Telegram's app id for Phoenix (a build-time setting) and TDLib (phoenix-tdjson), which the image brings.
